asr.full_text: Welcome to Cryptocurrency eLearning. In this section, we will go through how you become a part of the mining pool and the creation of cryptocurrency. There are two different ways to get hold of cryptocurrency. One way to buy Bitcoin from someone who chooses to sell, for example through Qubits.com or any similar trading platform. Another way is to mine bitcoins or any other cryptocurrency. It's a process that is very technical and have until now mainly attracted programmers. To be part of a mining pool can be very profitable and is a relatively easy process via Bitclub network. This network has over the last three years, grown their market shares with their growing club of miners. To be part of this pool and to mine atby coines, you need to be specially invited by a club member. An existing member can create a link to a new account via the button, enroll member. This is where you put in the new member's personal information after the enrollment process, the new member can login to their own Bitclub account they need to verify their account, which is easily done by clicking the Send Verification Code go to the registered e-mail and copy the code that has been sent. Fill in the empty field in the BitClub account and verify. After logging in to your BitClub account you will find information and videos about the Club's physical mining parks . When you join the mining pool, a $99 activation fee will be charged you can only pay this fee in bitcoins which is the only payment method for BitClub Click on upgrade me when you click upgrade me you will see 1. a clock ticking 10 minutes 2. the amount you have to pay in bitcoin and three a bitcoin address where you will be sending the bitcoins order to pay with bitcoin you have to do this from your own bitcoin wallet in this case qubits you only have 10 minutes to complete your upgrade if the payment has not been completed within 10 minutes, you have to start the process again. Copy the address in your BitClub account and go to your Bitcoin wallet . Click Send Money and paste the address go back to the bitclub page and copy the amount in Bitcoin and paste it into your Bitcoin wallet and click send money it may take a few hours for the transfer to complete. Once the membership is activated, you go to buy mining shares. Here you can choose from six different packages with different benefits. Once you have selected the mining pool you want it's the same procedure as when you upgraded the account and paid from your Bitcoin wallet cubit. When your mining pool is paid, it may take between two to 24 hours before it gets activated. Please note that it takes 30 days before your pool is connected to the physical mining pool. Once connected to the pool, you have mining with a daily payout for 1000 or 2000 days, depending on whether you selected a bitcoin mining pool or a GPU mining pool. Once the membership is paid and activated, the member can be placed in the binary structure by the sponsor. Click on MY TEAM and B binary tree and scroll down. Click down the binary structure to the desired position. If you click on the lowest position, you will move further down in the network. Click on Select user and Select member username. Then click on Add member and confirm the location. Now the member is successfully placed.
